summary: Profile dropdown was simplified to a single "My Profile" navigation item and logout, removing any modal-based edit flow. ProfilePage was updated to support initializing edit mode from an `edit=1` URL parameter and to clear that parameter on save/cancel. However, the dropdown does not provide a way to navigate into edit mode (e.g., `/profile?edit=1`), so the "option to land directly in edit mode when navigated from the profile dropdown" is not evidenced as implemented. Additional URL/session parameter utility functionality appears added beyond the stated requirements.

missing_requirements.requirement: Provide an option to land directly in edit mode when navigated from the profile dropdown (e.g., via a URL query parameter like ?edit=1).
missing_requirements.reason: ProfileMenu navigates only to `/profile` with no edit indicator, so there is no evidenced path from the dropdown that initializes ProfilePage in edit mode via URL parameter.

hallucinated_features.description: Added sessionStorage-based persistence utilities for URL parameters (store/get/clear persisted URL parameters).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only asked for using a URL edit indicator for /profile; it did not request adding generalized persisted URL/session parameter helpers.
